_source: https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/fortnite/games-and-game-tags-in-fortnite-creative (fetched 2026-09-22) — Epic's own official closed list of Game Tags for Fortnite Creative islands.
_status: complete official list (149 tags) — note: this is the full CLOSED vocabulary, not yet cross-checked against real captures to see which subsets specific islands actually use.
_note_genre_vs_tag: As clarified on the same Epic page: 'Selecting a game tag is not the same as selecting a genre' — tags give additional info but do NOT determine eligibility for Discover rows (only the genre does that). Don't confuse this list with fortnite-genres-official.json.
_mechanism: The server (agent-console-server.py/.ps1), every time it reads /island-info for any island, must read the payload's 'tags' field and, for each observed tag: check it against 'officialTags' above (if it doesn't match, flag it as an anomaly to review, don't silently discard it — it could indicate a new, not-yet-documented tag); update 'observedOnIslands' below with firstSeen/lastSeen/timesObserved to track real usage, not just theoretical existence.

_schema_observed.tag: exact string as returned by the API
